name: Page Trace
summary: An on-this-page menu for docs where a glowing line traces the sections you can see as you scroll
about: A documentation page with an On this page menu beside it. A line runs down the menu, stepping in and out with the headings, and the stretch that matches what is on screen lights up and glides with a coral bead as you scroll, while the section you are reading gets a highlighter stroke. Click a heading to glide there and flash it; a progress ring counts the minutes left, code blocks copy for real and the page asks if it helped.
how: Scroll the article with the wheel, a finger or the keyboard and watch the trace follow.
Click a heading in On this page to glide to it, or the arrow button to go back to the top.
Press Copy on a code block to copy it.
A demo plays by itself until you click, tap, scroll or press a key.
